sanskrit:
अहङ्कारं बलं दर्पं कामं क्रोधं परिग्रहम् ।
विमुच्य निर्ममः शान्तो ब्रह्मभूयाय कल्पते ॥ १८-५३॥
iast:
ahaṅkāraṃ balaṃ darpaṃ kāmaṃ krodhaṃ parigraham
vimucya nirmamaḥ śānto brahmabhūyāya kalpate 18-53
translation: Having abandoned egoism, power, arrogance, desire, anger and aggrandisement, and freed from the notion of mine,  and so peaceful — he is fit to become BRAHMAN.
